metadata.description: Content and workflow plugins for Claude Code: YouTube and podcast transcript extraction and summarization (youtube-transcript, podcast-transcript), autonomous planning and unattended execution (supergoal, autonomous-run), and outcome docs carried from intent to proof (promise).

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: Extract YouTube captions/transcripts, transcribe local audio/video files, summarize transcript files, and fall back to OpenAI audio transcription when captions are unavailable.

plugins.name: podcast-transcript
plugins.description: Extract podcast transcripts from Spotify episode links, Apple Podcasts episode links, public RSS feeds, direct transcript/audio URLs, and local media; save clean Markdown and metadata, with optional summaries.

plugins.name: supergoal
plugins.description: Plan and autonomously build a software task end-to-end under a single /goal, with retry, fix-spec recovery, per-phase memory writeback, and a final audit. Cross-platform (PowerShell + POSIX helpers). Adapted for Windows from supergoal by Robert Courson.

plugins.name: autonomous-run
plugins.description: Configure Claude Code for a long unattended run: auto permissions, dynamic-workflow subagent fan-out, /goal or /loop persistence, cloud execution, and end-to-end self-verification. Detects which levers are available and hands off cleanly. Pairs with supergoal.

plugins.name: promise
plugins.description: Write the promise before the build, then prove it kept. You write the outcome and rules in your own words, the model may argue in notes but never rewrite them, a linter checks the doc, and your acceptance rows are committed as failing tests before any code is written.
